--- COMMAND: show running-config ---
hostname sw-core-01
!
vlan 10
 name Corp-LAN
vlan 20
 name Voice
vlan 99
 name Management
!
ip name-server 9.9.9.9
ntp server 10.10.99.50
logging host 10.10.99.51
!
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/1
 description Uplink to fw-edge-01
 switchport access vlan 10
 switchport mode access
!
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/2
 description Unused-Port
 shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/24
 description Trunk to sw-access-01
 switchport trunk native vlan 10
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 10,20,99
 switchport mode trunk
!
interface Vlan10
 description Corp-LAN-SVI
 ip address 10.10.1.2 255.255.255.0
 ip helper-address 10.10.99.50
 standby 10 ip 10.10.1.254
 standby 10 priority 110
!
interface Vlan20
 description Voice-VLAN-SVI
 ip address 10.10.20.2 255.255.255.0
 ip helper-address 10.10.99.50
!
ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 10.10.1.1
end
